root_cause: memory_format_evidence.inspect_format currently admits only user/assistant, but the installed v2.2.5 Message.Info union includes genuine idle lifecycle records. Closed plain trace contains one schema-valid idle/succeeded record with no tool content.

genuine_message_variants.assistant: Only Message.Info variant with an executable tool-part content array. Required content array must not be silently replaced with an empty default.
genuine_message_variants.user: Text/files/agents/skills inputs; not a tool-execution record. Official schema also forbids extra content/tool_calls fields.
genuine_message_variants.idle: id,time.created,type,outcome required; metadata/error optional. Outcome succeeded/failed/interrupted. No content/tool_calls permitted.
genuine_message_variants.agent-switched: agent required, previous optional; benchmark agent invariance needs a separate check.
genuine_message_variants.model-switched: model required, previous optional; benchmark frozen-model invariance needs a separate check.
genuine_message_variants.location-switched: location required; optional projectID/subpath/previous; workspace isolation must be checked separately.
genuine_message_variants.synthetic: Required text, optional description; text data not tool execution.
genuine_message_variants.system: Required text, optional description; text data not tool execution.
genuine_message_variants.skill: Required skill/name/text; not an executable tool-part carrier.
genuine_message_variants.shell: Native shell execution outside assistant parts; command/status required, output/exit/completed optional. Not an MCP tool part, but retain command/mutation/resource evidence.
genuine_message_variants.compaction: Running/completed/failed variants. Summary or error fields; may contain model/native/tokens/cost but no tool array. Resource/usage completeness must remain separately enforced.

minimal_fix_proposal.scope: Admit strictly schema-valid idle only as the immediate repair: this covers all36closedv3 plus closedv4plain observations. Leave other genuine but unobserved union variants unsupported until explicitly schema-covered; never skip all non-assistant records.
constraints: time exactly {created: finite JSON number}; bool is not a number
Reject all extra fields, especially content/tool_calls/state or nested time extras
preserve: Scan every genuine assistant tool part
Do not use missing assistant.content as empty valid input
Keep argument+receipt visible/backend multiset equality; real backend calls with no assistant carrier must still fail
Recognized idle failed/interrupted is not operational success; preserve separate outcome/failure handling and costs
minimal_fix_proposal.broader_supported_boundary: If covering all11 variants, use their explicit required/allowed keys and types from pinned schemas, not a typename-only whitelist. Report recognized model/agent/location switches and compaction/shell data to their separate protocol/resource validators.

regression_proposal: Real closed metadata-only idle fixture passes plain format inspection with zero observations, rather than unsupported schema.
Legal failed/interrupted idle records are recognized without converting the run to success.
Idle plus content containing a memory tool, tool_calls or any other unexpected field rejects.
Unknown message type rejects; malformed id/time/outcome/metadata/error rejects.
Missing/malformed assistant content rejects instead of disappearing as not_observed.
An actual assistant memory call beside idle still matches its backend receipt; absent/extra/duplicate backend calls reject.
A forged lifecycle record cannot replace an assistant memory call and evade backend reconciliation.
Existing schema1/full and schema2/compact argument+receipt matching remains unchanged.
